candidates.title: How Worldwide Express automated freight exceptions with Amazon Bedrock
candidates.summary: Worldwide Express automated its less-than-truckload freight billing-exception process with a multi-agent solution built on Amazon Bedrock. Six months after launch, the company cut active exceptions by 75%, improved time-to-cash by four weeks, and unlocked $10 million in free cash flow.

candidates.title: Configure the ChatGPT desktop app with Amazon Bedrock in AWS GovCloud (US)
candidates.summary: The ChatGPT desktop app is now available on Amazon Bedrock in AWS GovCloud (US). This post walks through a controlled local deployment that routes model inference to Amazon Bedrock in AWS GovCloud (US-West) using API-mode sign-in, a managed device policy, a named AWS profile, and network restrictions, so a security team can validate it before broader use.
